name: LoveMoney
source:
Life has tied you to a necessary operation that is required to save your life. It costs you money that is beyond your means, so when you leave the hospital, you stumble upon a small booth with a nice person who becomes the solution to your problem.

A fan-made sequel to BloodMoney, where you can not only pet Harvey, but also kiss, touch and even fuck him.

[From [url=https://buwu3.itch.io/llllollll]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活已将你与挽救生命所需的必要手术联系在一起。这会花费你超出你能力范围的钱，所以当你离开医院时，你偶然发现一个小摊位，里面有一个好人，他成为你问题的解决方案。

粉丝制作的《血钱》续集，你不仅可以抚摸哈维，还可以亲吻、触摸甚至操他。

[来自[url=https://buwu3.itch.io/llllollll]Itch.io[/url]]
